thread:
sophie: Heads up — a bunch of dashboard sparklines and small metric panels are stuck on 'Loading...' for multiple orgs. I can repro in our prod tenant and customer AcmeCorp is hitting this in a demo. Network tab shows POST /v1/analytics/query returning 504s and some 500s. Started ~09:12 UTC.

kev: ugh. Can you paste the request id/org id and a sample curl? Also assign severity — is this blocking customer-visible dashboards? :rotating_light:

sophie: org=acme-demo, request_id=01H7X... (cut). Repro steps: open /console/orgs/acme-demo/dashboards/overview -> open network -> click refresh. Curl: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/analytics/query \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query":"SELECT time_bucket, avg(latency) FROM metrics ...","range":"30m"}' \n  -i

HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"gateway timeout","code":504}
```

sophie: Impact: multiple small widgets on the console empty, customers emailing support, demos blocked.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: aggregator-service v3.2.0 -> prod @ 2026-03-17T09:09:12Z (sha: ab12cd).

sam: I'm looking. Seeing a large tail on analytics-api -> long waits on clickhouse queries. Correlates with aggregator v3.2.0 rollout. Q95 tokenization and GROUP BY rewrites changed. Query timeouts spiking to 10s+.

li: we shipped an optimizer that rewrites some aggregations into wider scans. I pushed that to v3.2 because of perf tests but maybe missed some cardinality patterns. Trying to reproduce locally with acme-demo query.

kev: severity P1. Customer-facing dashboards down for at least 1 paid customer. @sam can you open an incident and request rollback? I'll create support ticket and notify CSM.

sam: opening incident now. Incident #INC-20260317-42. Recommending immediate rollback to v3.1.x on prod while we roll forward a fix. Starting rollback.

ops-bot: rollback initiated: aggregator-service -> v3.1.9 (targeting prod) by sam at 2026-03-17T09:16:04Z.

sam: also adding a short-term mitigation — increase analytics-api query timeout from 6s -> 20s to avoid 504s while rollback progresses (risky but reduces customer impact). Pushing change to config now.

li: on it — digging into the rewrite; I can produce a patch to gate the optimizer path by dataset cardinality. Will validate on staging once rollback completes.

sophie: after rollback there's an immediate improvement — I see panels start loading again, a few errors still but much better. AcmeCorp reports dashboards are back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment complete: aggregator-service rolled back to v3.1.9 at 2026-03-17T09:20:58Z.

sam: monitoring — clickhouse tail latencies dropping back to baseline. I'll keep incident open until we verify 30m of stable metrics.

kev: filing postmortem and linking the incident. Sophie, please paste any customer-facing timings/messages so SRE/CS can communicate.

sophie: Will do. Thanks everyone.

li: filing a PR with a revert + guarded optimizer; testing now.

sam: closing loop — remediation worked, follow-up action items assigned in the incident.

kev: nice work team. Add notes to the dashboard incident channel for runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
